captions.detailed: A low-profile benchtop monocular microscope consisting of a thick black rectangular base, a dark gray curved supporting arm, and a black optical head with an angled eyepiece tube pointing upwards. It features a light gray square stage platform positioned beneath the objective nosepiece, which is equipped with small cylindrical objectives. The optical head carriage slides vertically along a dual-rod guide on the arm, the stage carrier slides horizontally from left to right, and the objective nosepiece is designed to rotate on a central turret joint.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a low-profile benchtop monocular microscope with a thick rectangular base, a curved supporting arm, and a square specimen stage. The assembly must include a vertically sliding optical head carriage, a horizontally sliding stage plate, and a rotatable objective nosepiece turret with multiple objectives.
captions.factory: Construct the base using a thick box primitive and the curved arm by lofting or extruding a polygonal profile. Model the vertical guide rods as thin cylinders and the stage as a flat box. Create the optical head carriage, angled eyepiece tube, and rotating nosepiece using combined box and cylinder primitives. Define prismatic joint articulations for the vertical focus movement of the head carriage and the lateral movement of the stage carrier, and a revolute joint for the objective turret rotation.
